I was walking through the park between meetings today and somehow discovered that Seoul has a free zoo. 😭 Then I came face to face with one of the biggest tigers I’ve ever seen. For a second, we both started scratching our necks at the exact same time… and then we both stopped at the exact same time. That’s when he slowly walked over, licked his lips, stared straight at me… and suddenly I wasn’t feeling nearly as brave anymore. 😂 Lately I’ve been trying to be as creative as possible to get more people to discover and stream Dream Higher. Apparently nobody is safe from the promo, not even the tiger. Jokes aside, I try to walk around 10,000 steps every day.
